features.name: Review portable folders through Export, Share and Send Page
features.limitation: Original HTML/CMGFM only. Native share sheets use a visible save-and-share fallback. Download-enabled hosts receive ZIP. Outside or missing local references stop preparation.
features.notes: Transient review and handoff are verified through engine and UI tests instead of authored demo content. Windows tests cover preparation, cancellation, Back, keyboard activation, accessible narrow light/dark layouts, source preservation, desktop output and browser ZIP delivery. Store tests export both complete official demo editions. RedMesa and deployed online builds were not checked.

features.name: Search open notebooks and navigate results
features.limitation: Enter opens the first match; arrow-key result navigation is not implemented.
features.notes: Windows semantic tests cover keyboard focus, dismissal, result selection, Android Back routing and unchanged page content. Light and dark captures were inspected. This transient flow is verified through tests instead of authored demo content.

features.name: Import OneNote folders, sections and packages through the installed bridge
features.limitation: Flat bridge exports remain one combined page per section. Original page boundaries cannot be reconstructed; unsupported HTML remains read-only.
features.notes: Windows local smoke tests use the installed bridge and public OneNote fixtures in both formats. Test data covers actual destination reporting, page-owned assets, cancellation and metadata-only ID updates. Network-share behavior and other delivery targets remain unverified.

features.name: Layered embedded objects
features.notes: Must cover object hit testing, z-order, selection, movement, and resizing.

features.name: File attachments
features.limitation: Insert dialog and copy operation are under active verification.
features.notes: Keep image, video, audio, and generic-file behavior distinct.

features.name: Themes and visual states
features.limitation: Visual verification is still required for each supported theme.
features.notes: Check normal, hover, pressed, focused, disabled, and selected states.

features.name: RTL text and caret behavior
features.limitation: The product requirement remains broader than the current verification set.
features.notes: Include Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu, mixed direction, selection, paste, and undo.

features.name: Local logging and telemetry
features.limitation: Nothing is sent automatically; export is user initiated.
features.notes: Keep logging levels, session IDs, retention, export, and clear behavior documented.

features.name: Corruption tolerance and user-approved repair
features.limitation: Parser diagnostics and the repair-permission flow are not implemented yet.
features.notes: Never silently overwrite a damaged page; denial must be logged at error level.
